title: Keep the Signal Alive
style: Cinematic painted key art for a modern real-time strategy game, the look of classic Command and Conquer box art: dramatic light, rich colour, crisp detail, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no letters, no flags, no insignia.

music.caption: gritty defensive cinematic underscore, heavy percussion and distorted low drums, tense string ostinato, a stubborn rising theme, ends with a driving charge, no vocals

shots.prompt: A lone field radio relay mast on a rocky hill in a fictional training ground at dusk, cables running down to a small sandbagged hut, distant hills, wind, isolated and important.
shots.line: One field relay connects your forward teams to their supply base.

shots.prompt: Turn this top-down game map into a glowing holographic tactical map projected on a dark command table, seen at a slight angle. Keep the terrain layout, coastline and roads of the reference. Add a pulsing blue relay icon, red incoming attack arrows from the far side, a red enemy command post marker, amber light.
shots.line: In this exercise, the attacks arrive before your workshop is secure.

shots.prompt: A busy field workshop being built in a valley: trucks unloading crates, engineers welding, a small depot growing behind sandbags, warm work lights at dusk.
shots.line: Expand the economy, build the workshop, and assemble a mixed defence.

shots.prompt: Portrait of a fictional field signals commander in his forties, short dark beard, plain olive fatigues without any badges or insignia, headset, standing beside radio equipment in a dim bunker, determined, looking at the viewer, cinematic rim light, painted portrait.
shots.line: Hold the line. Keep the signal alive.

shots.prompt: Night defence at a river ford in a training exercise: anti-tank teams behind sandbags, tracer light, armoured vehicles advancing through shallow water in the distance, flares overhead, intense and dramatic.
shots.line: Mix anti-tank teams with reconnaissance, and keep a reserve at the base.

shots.prompt: Dawn after the battle: a column of light vehicles crossing the ford toward a distant enemy command post on a hill, the relay mast standing behind them with its light still on, hopeful and resolute.
shots.line: Then turn the defence into an assault.
